body: A central challenge for scientific agents is to turn analytical experience into reusable expertise grounded in physical evidence. Here we introduce Gan Jiang, a self-learning agent for powder X-ray diffraction built on a diffraction-analysis ecosystem we developed: XMatcher, XQueryer, XDecomposer and WPEM. Together, these engines span phase identification, multiphase decomposition and physics-constrained whole-pattern modelling. Gan Jiang converts analytical experience into executable skills by diagnosing failures, revising skill instructions and code, and validating revisions before reuse, without retraining the language model or changing the underlying physical models. Skills selected using development data and frozen before held-out evaluation achieve higher refinement scores than the original expert-designed skills across FullProf, GSAS-II and PyWPEM. The agent resolves strongly overlapping reflections, quantifies a five-phase ancient Egyptian cosmetic, tracks lattice evolution in an operating battery and compares atomic configurations in a disordered oxide catalyst. On DeltaXRDbench, it leads the evaluated methods in single- and multiphase identification across simulated and experimental data. Without supplied composition, single-phase top-1 accuracies reach 96.30%, 81.78% and 40.83% on MP500, RRUFF and opXRD, respectively, compared with 58.00%, 58.47% and 26.45% for the strongest comparator. These results demonstrate how an integrated scientific tool ecosystem can support agents that extract structural knowledge from measurements while accumulating validated analytical expertise that transfers to new samples.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了Gan Jiang，一个专为粉末X射线衍射（XRD）设计的自学习科学智能体。该系统集成了一套物理约束的分析工具链（XMatcher, XQueryer, XDecomposer, WPEM），能够将分析经验转化为可执行的技能。通过诊断失败、修正指令与代码并进行验证，该智能体在无需重训练模型的情况下，实现了对物相识别、多相分解及晶格演化追踪的自动化。在DeltaXRDbench测试中，其在单相和多相识别任务上均大幅超越现有方法，证明了集成化科学工具生态在提取结构知识与积累分析经验方面的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种用于分析物质晶体结构的物理实验技术。
指模型或算法在执行过程中受到物理定律的约束，以确保结果的科学合理性。
通过衍射数据确定样品中存在的化学物相的过程。
将复杂的混合物衍射图谱拆解为多个单一物相贡献的过程。
指晶体结构在外部条件（如电池充放电）下发生的晶格参数变化。
